content.user_title: Build WeChat Mini Programs with CloudBase
content.value_statement: WeChat Mini Program work requires platform-specific structure, preview, and CloudBase decisions. This skill guides setup, debugging, release checks, and CloudBase integration.
actual_capabilities: Guides Mini Program page, component, structure, and configuration work.
Checks project configuration, appid, and miniprogramRoot before preview or publishing.
Recommends WeChat Developer Tools first, with miniprogram-ci as a fallback.
Provides a text-only custom tabBar default and minimal project skeleton guidance.
Routes CloudBase work to wx.cloud initialization, identity, database, and storage rules.
Lists pitfalls for syntax support, TDesign styling, canvas storage, and environment drift.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run WeChat Developer Tools itself.
CloudBase guidance applies only when the project already uses CloudBase.
Payment, refund, and Official Account OAuth work is delegated to another skill.
Some sibling guidance is referenced outside this package.

use_cases.title: Create Mini Program Pages
use_cases.description: Plan page files, component structure, routing, and required configuration for a new feature.

use_cases.title: Review Preview Readiness
use_cases.description: Check project configuration, appid, miniprogramRoot, assets, and preview workflow before device testing.

use_cases.title: Add CloudBase Integration
use_cases.description: Apply wx.cloud patterns for environment setup, identity, database access, storage, and cloud functions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a Mini Program feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WeChat Mini Program page for [feature]. Include required page files and explain where each file belongs.

prompt_templates.title: Review Project Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Mini Program project configuration for preview readiness. Check appid, miniprogramRoot, page registration, and asset paths.

prompt_templates.title: Add CloudBase Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CloudBase data flow for [feature]. Use wx.cloud correctly and separate client-safe writes from privileged cloud function work.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Release Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this Mini Program for preview or upload. Identify required checks for DevTools, real-device testing, miniprogram-ci, and release gates.

output_examples.input: Review a Mini Program tab bar that has unwanted icon spacing.
output: Recommends a text-only custom tabBar when icons are not required.
Explains which layout properties remove blank icon space.
Lists files that need coordinated changes.

output_examples.input: Plan CloudBase support for user-generated image uploads.
output: Separates client upload steps from permission-sensitive server logic.
Calls out environment selection and storage permission checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a project for real-device preview.
output: Checks appid, miniprogramRoot, page registration, and local assets.
Prefers WeChat Developer Tools for simulator and device testing.
Uses miniprogram-ci only when DevTools is unavailable.

best_practices: Confirm the configured Mini Program root before editing page files.
Use CloudBase rules only when the project clearly uses CloudBase.
Complete preview and release checks before upload or publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not copy Web authentication patterns into Mini Programs.
Do not create icon-based tab bars when text-only tabs meet the requirement.
Do not publish without checking appid, assets, and project configuration.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports WeChat Mini Program projects, especially projects that need structure, preview, release, or CloudBase guidance.

faq.question: Does it require CloudBase?
faq.answer: No. It applies CloudBase rules only when the user or codebase shows CloudBase usage.

faq.question: Can it help with WeChat Developer Tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides simulator, panel debugging, preview, and real-device validation workflows.

faq.question: Can it use miniprogram-ci?
faq.answer: Yes. It treats miniprogram-ci as a fallback for preview, upload, and build workflows.

faq.question: Does it cover WeChat Pay?
faq.answer: Only at the routing level. Payment callbacks, refunds, and OAuth details are delegated to another skill.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
